clue.text: I certainly don't know how "marchese" is translated

explanation.definitionFit: In baseball the shortstop is the fielder placed between second and third base.

clue.text: Prison education provided in this spacious area?

clue.text: Unusually polite old artist

clue.text: Minor member of King Arthur's court for a time
